import parse

# Test R8 - findall case_sensitive
print('=== R8: findall case_sensitive ===')
p = parse.compile('{word}')
result1 = p.findall('Hello hello HELLO', case_sensitive=True)
result2 = p.findall('Hello hello HELLO', case_sensitive=False)
print(f'case_sensitive=True: {result1}')
print(f'case_sensitive=False: {result2}')

# Test R6 - hex/binary/octal conversion
print('\n=== R6: Hex/Binary/Octal conversion ===')
r1 = parse.parse('{:x}', 'deadbeef')
print(f'Hex {:x}: {r1}')
r2 = parse.parse('{:b}', '10101010')
print(f'Binary {:b}: {r2}')
r3 = parse.parse('{:o}', '777')
print(f'Octal {:o}: {r3}')
r4 = parse.parse('{:#x}', '0xdead')
print(f'Hex with prefix: {r4}')

# Test R7 - picklable converters
print('\n=== R7: Picklable converters ===')
import pickle
from parse import FloatConverter, DecimalConverter, IntConverter

fc = FloatConverter()
dc = DecimalConverter()
ic = IntConverter(10)

print(f'FloatConverter picklable: {pickle.dumps(fc) is not None}')
print(f'DecimalConverter picklable: {pickle.dumps(dc) is not None}')
print(f'IntConverter picklable: {pickle.dumps(ic) is not None}')

# Test R10 - Result slice access
print('\n=== R10: Result slice access ===')
r = parse.parse('{a} {b} {c} {d}', 'one two three four')
print(f'Full result: {r}')
print(f'Slice [1:3]: {r[1:3]}')
print(f'Slice ::2: {r[::2]}')
"
